title: Conditional dual-regression martingale hierarchy
statement: For every information sigma-field G on the random order, the conditional regression certificate C_G=E[P_G Q_G^{-1}P_G] lower-bounds the exact inverse moment K. Refining G monotonically strengthens C_G, and the full-order field gives equality. Conditioning on a directed cycle and averaging its cut yields an exact arc-incidence covariance representation for half-window residuals.
assumptions: The local-inverse dual feature is positive definite
Conditional expectations are taken over a finite uniform permutation space
Matrix inverses are interpreted on the documented supported range where needed
open_objections: No dimension-free lower bound for the cycle-conditioned certificate has yet been proved.
The nested arc Hardy/Copson kernel and its cross term with the baseline remain open.
No priority audit, formalization, or external-human validation exists.
